# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-27

This Xteink X4 Pro release adds one-button full library synchronization with Calibre Content Server.

## Added

- Added full Calibre library synchronization to each configured OPDS server.
- Downloads new and updated EPUB books by following every page of the Calibre OPDS catalog.
- Removes books that disappeared from Calibre while leaving manually copied files untouched.
- Shows synchronization progress and a summary of added, updated, removed, and failed items.

## Reliability

- Uses stable OPDS book identifiers and update timestamps to detect changes.
- Downloads to a temporary file and keeps a backup during replacement.
- Preserves local reading progress when an existing EPUB is updated.
- Supports cancelling an in-progress synchronization.

## Notes

- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 Pro only.
- The OTA binary is published through the self-hosted CrossPoint release service.
